answer: Joint-liability cohort admission: a new identity joins only inside a random cohort of seven strangers who co-sign one another's first work, each member's stake held in escrow against the whole cohort. Like a tide that lifts or strands every boat in one ocean inlet, one proven fake sinks all seven: they lose stake and standing, so honest members audit cohort-mates before signing. Bulk puppets placed together die together at first detection, and puppets smuggled into honest cohorts are exposed by members guarding their escrow; the zenith of full trust costs forfeited escrow or real honest work.
